name: flp-all-models
description: Single Model Serving endpoint hosting all 8 FLP models wrapped in one pyfunc entity (flp_catalog.models.flp_all). Dispatch via the 'model_name' input column: h1, h2a, h2b, h3r, h3c, h4a, h4b, h4c, or all. Note: free-tier workspace allows only 2 endpoints / 2 provisioned concurrency, hence the single combined entity.
